chunks.text: NVDA expects gross margin guidance of approximately 75% for the next fiscal quarter, driven by data center demand.
The company reported strong revenue growth in its gaming segment year over year.
Operating expenses increased due to research and development investments.

query: free cash flow for the quarter

chunks.text: Free cash flow for the quarter was $3.1 billion, up from $2.4 billion a year ago.
Cash and cash equivalents totaled $18 billion at period end.
The board approved a new share repurchase program.

query: total revenue year over year change

chunks.text: Total revenue increased 12% year over year to $24.9 billion this quarter.
Net income margin expanded by 200 basis points compared to the prior year.
Headcount grew modestly during the period across engineering teams.
